body_lead: The Human Rights Forum (HRF) demands that the Telangana government suspend the implementation of existing commitments and refrain from making any further commitments for hyperscale AI data centers until independent, publicly accessible assessments establish that their water and energy requirements will not compromise drinking water, agriculture or ecological needs. All existing and proposed projects must be assessed cumulatively, with public consultation and enforceable limits on resource use.
